scientific_integrity: Geodesic-triple enumeration and a separately implemented generating-function calculation agree for all n from 5 through 13. All-parameter assertions use the supplied structural and transfer-matrix proof; no independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns labeled maximal general-position sets of \(K_1\vee C_n\) for all \(n\ge5\). The key rim configurations are also maximal dissociation sets of cycles. A relevant 2024 cyclic-grid dissociation enumeration paper was accessible only through its abstract; prior equivalence remains a publication-priority risk.
title: The maximal general-position polynomial of wheel graphs
